snippet.title: Moonbrella Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433800/Moonbrella/
Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/jett-williams/moonbrella

A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.
